title: glosa Core Epistemic Structure
description: tier: Dr (specified; independently unreviewed). methodology/P20_core_epistemic_structure.md, founder ruling 2026-09-07 (Blackbox Log BBL-2026-09-07-216/217/218) -- the three-role attribution block (Core Respondent / Experience-Based Expert, Interactional Expert, AI Model(s) Used), formal object E_p = <X_p^exp, X_p^int, M_p^AI>. Template: templates/core_epistemic_structure.md. Namespace https://glosa.example/ is a placeholder -- glosa has no public domain yet.

respondent.description: Core Respondent / Experience-Based Expert -- non-empty, and must carry a basis (X_p^exp: Exp/Sel/Int). Either a single string 'name -- basis' (em dash or double-hyphen separator, matching the Markdown/LaTeX prose form) or a structured {name, basis} object.

interactional.description: A name/role, or exactly 'None'. 'None' is itself epistemic information (X_p^int = the empty set / the role is unheld) -- never a placeholder or a fabricated name to fill the slot.

ai_models.description: M_p^AI: at least one {model, role} entry naming every model that actually played a part, or exactly the string 'None' when no model was used. The bare phrase 'AI was used' (with no model named) is never a legal value at either shape.
